strengths: Top 50 technical indicators are 100% calculated, mathematically verified, and strictly look-ahead free.

High collinearity among moving averages (SMA_10, EMA_9, etc.) requires feature pruning before training linear models.
engine_01_short_term_trading.proceed_to_phase4_recommendation: APPROVED to proceed with baseline ML models (XGBoost / LightGBM) on technical and volume features, excluding static announcement flags.
